title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-Margined COOKIEUSDT, ALCHUSDT, and SWARMSUSDT Perpetual Contracts With up to 75x Leverage
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the aforementioned perpetual contracts.  The aforementioned perpetual contracts are subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
